name: APG Guider (rule-based, MD fork of blepping)
plain: A guider with an ordered list of rules: for each sigma the first matching rule sets cfg, APG scale, momentum, blend. It can run APG as cfg function or pre-CFG per rule.
math: Rule by σ ≤ start_sigma; matched rule with apg_blend≠0 and apg_scale≠0: disable cfg1, run rule.cfg_function (cfg=rule.cfg) or pre_cfg_function (cfg=apg_scale). Otherwise plain cfg=rule.cfg. Core update math is in apg_guider_core.py with momentum modes and lerp/slerp blends (partly read).

props.params: rules YAML; start_sigma, momentum=-0.5, eta, apg_scale, norm_threshold, dims, update_mode, update_blend_mode, cfg, apg_blend, apg_blend_mode, predict_image=true, pre_cfg_mode

providers.author: MDMAchine
providers.note: imports a binary or source core module

label: inference
surprise: The pack first tries to import a compiled apg_guider_core_bin before falling back to source.
